caption: Shot 0 opens in a medium view of a small watch-repair workshop. An elderly watchmaker with a neatly trimmed silver-gray beard, thick dark eyebrows, round brass-rimmed glasses, and a small dark mole on his left cheekbone sits at a cluttered wooden bench under a warm tungsten desk lamp. He wears a deep-green wool vest over a cream shirt and a brown leather apron, and he leans toward an open pocket watch resting on a felt pad while shelves of antique clocks fill the wall behind him.
